answer: Bond-weighted attestation: each new agent locks a small stake that stays frozen for 30 days, and its votes count only in proportion to that stake times its age. A sybil farm spinning up a comet-like burst of 1,000 fresh identities must lock 1,000 stakes and still waits out the cold tundra of probation, so a sudden gale of fake votes costs real capital yet carries almost no weight. Proven collusion slashes the bonds of every linked account.
